findings.evidence: `rg` confirms the embedding claims at lines 51 and 126; the declaration at lines 128–129 assumes only finiteness on compact sets and `1 ≤ p`, allowing the zero measure.
findings.fix: Call it a dense linear map in both locations; qualify any injectivity claim with sufficient assumptions.
findings.issue: The docstring calls `D1p0.ofTestFunctionₗ` a linear embedding, also at line 51, although the permitted measure `mu = 0` sends every test function to zero.

findings.evidence: The ambient assumptions at lines 81–83 require finite dimension but not positive dimension. On the singleton real inner product space with its full-support Haar measure and `Omega = ⊤`, the constant-one test function has zero gradient.
findings.fix: Add a positive-dimension qualification to these claims, or describe the construction uniformly as the completion after quotienting by the seminorm kernel.
findings.issue: Full support alone does not make the gradient seminorm a norm, contrary to lines 31–32, 93–94 and 108–109: the allowed zero-dimensional space has nonzero compactly supported constant functions with zero gradient.

summary: The documentation overstates injectivity of the test-function map and the conditions under which the gradient seminorm is a norm.
